newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks dip at noon on settlement day.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks dip at noon on settlement day.

text.p: Pakistani stocks dipped at noon on Monday as prices of blue chips eased on settlement day position-squaring, but brokers said they see a turn around in the near term.

The Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index fell 3.92 points, or 0.29 percent, to 1,359.09 at noon. Losers led gainers 117 to 52. "Prices are now at attractive level, " dealer Rony Byramjee said. "People expect the government to announce a relief package for the stock markets." The Karachi bourse shed 352.66 points since a tax-packed budget was announced on June 13. PTCL fell 0.20 rupees to 33.80. -- Amir Zia 9221-5685192
